question: Who was the host of the Asian Games 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indonesia.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Asian Games 2018:**

__
 
• It was **held in Indonesia** (Jakarta and Palembang) **from August 18 to September 2, 2018**.
 
• This was Indonesia's **second hosting** of the Asian Games; the first took place in Jakarta in 1962.
 
• **Canoe polo and eSports**, a type of competition utilizing video games, were also held for the **first time as demonstration sports.**
 
• India had 15 gold, 24 silver, and 30 bronze medals.
 
• The **mascots** of this edition are:
 
 
• Atung(deer).
 
• Kaka (one-horned rhino).
 
• Trio of Bhin Bhin (bird of paradise).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Asians Games:

 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from across Asia.
 
• They were regulated by the Asian Games Federation (AGF) till 1978.
 
• The first games were in New Delhi, India, in 1951.
 
• Since the breakup of the Asian Games Federation in 1982, the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) has organized the Games.
 
• The Games are recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and are described as the second largest multi-sport event after the Olympic Games.
 
• The next edition is expected to be held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan in 2026.
